subscription_products.product_name: Purina Pro Plan Puppy Small Breed Chicken & Rice Formula Dry Dog Food, 18-lb bag
subscription_products.subscription_rationale: Thor is a 2-month-old, 10 lb, high-activity pug puppy. Small-breed puppies of this size typically eat ~1.0–1.5 cups/day; using 1.25 cups/day for a growing, active pup: 1.25 cups/day × 30 days = 37.5 cups/month. Kibble approx. 1 cup ≈ 4 oz (1 lb ≈ 4 cups) → 18 lb bag ≈ 72 cups. 72 cups ÷ 37.5 cups/month ≈ 1.92 months. Autoship every ~8 weeks keeps food fresh and avoids running out during rapid growth and training.
subscription_products.personalized_note: Thor is growing quickly at 2 months and is very active — this small-breed puppy formula will support his energy needs and fit his short muzzle. I recommend starting with this 18-lb bag on an 8-week autoship so you won’t run out while you’re focused on house training and vet visits.

subscription_products.product_name: Purina Pro Plan Small Breed Chicken & Brown Rice Entree Wet Puppy Food, 156-g can, case of 24
subscription_products.subscription_rationale: Wet food is a useful topper/extra for picky eating or vaccination-day recovery. If you serve a 1/4 can as a topper 3–4 times/week, a case of 24 cans supplies ~6–8 weeks of occasional toppers. Autoship on a 2-month cadence keeps fresh cans on hand without overstocking.
subscription_products.personalized_note: Thor may enjoy a little wet food topper during transition and vaccinations — this case-sized option on an 8-week autoship ensures you have cans for meals or training rewards without cluttering your apartment.

subscription_products.product_name: Pupford Chicken Soft & Chewy Training Dog Treats, 5-oz pouch
subscription_products.subscription_rationale: Puppies need frequent, small rewards during house-training and early obedience. If you train 10 short reps/day using one 1/2-gram-sized soft treat per rep, you’ll go through roughly one 5-oz (≈142 g) pouch every 10–14 days. Autoship every 2 weeks prevents mid-training shortages.
subscription_products.personalized_note: Thor’s at the perfect age for lots of short training sessions — soft small treats are gentler on his 2-month-old teeth. A 2-week autoship keeps you stocked for daily rewards during housetraining in your apartment.

subscription_products.product_name: Pupford Beef Limited-Ingredient-Diet Adult Soft & Chewy Training Dog Treats, 5-oz bag
subscription_products.subscription_rationale: A second flavor keeps training novel and motivating. Same math as above: 5-oz pouch used ~10–14 days with frequent training. Alternate flavors on recurring deliveries so Thor stays engaged.
subscription_products.estimated_frequency: Every 2–3 weeks (staggered with other treat delivery)
subscription_products.personalized_note: Switching flavors keeps Thor excited during training — alternate chicken and beef on autoship so you always have something motivating during short bursts of practice in your apartment.

subscription_products.product_name: PetsWorld Puppy Potty Pads, Small: 24x24-in, 400 count, Unscented
subscription_products.subscription_rationale: Thor is 2 months old and apartment-only (no yard) so pads will be used heavily during early house training. Estimate: a young puppy typically needs supervised opportunities ~8–10 times/day; conservatively plan for 6 pad changes/day as training progresses → 6 pads/day × 30 = 180 pads/month. A 400-count pack covers ~2+ months; autoship every 10–12 weeks keeps a steady supply without clutter.
subscription_products.personalized_note: Because Thor is living in an apartment and just starting housetraining, these larger 400-count pads give you breathing room during early, messy weeks. I’d set deliveries a little less often (every ~10–12 weeks) so you’re stocked but not overwhelmed with extras.

subscription_products.product_name: Best Pet Supplies Disposable Puppy Pads Training Dog Potty Pads, Baby Pink, 23 x 22-in, 100 count
subscription_products.subscription_rationale: Keep a smaller, frequent backup pack for high-use weeks or emergencies. If you’re using ~6 pads/day, a 100-count pack covers ~16 days. A monthly autoship provides a fresh smaller pack during intense training phases.
subscription_products.personalized_note: Thor’s potty routine will change fast — a monthly 100-pack is a handy backup for the busiest training weeks so you never scramble for pads between your larger deliveries.

subscription_products.product_name: Shop Care Super Enzyme Pet Urine & Odor Destroyer, 32-fl oz bottle
subscription_products.subscription_rationale: Enzymatic cleaner is essential during house training to remove scent cues that prompt repeat accidents. Estimate one 32-oz bottle will cover ~4–6 weeks with routine spot cleaning (heavy early-phase use). Autoship every 6 weeks prevents scent re-marking in an apartment.
subscription_products.personalized_note: Thor’s small apartment means any missed accident can become a repeat target — keeping an enzymatic cleaner on a 6-week cadence will help you remove scent markers and speed up his housetraining.

subscription_products.product_name: Simple Green Bio Dog Stain & Odor Remover, 32-fl oz bottle
subscription_products.subscription_rationale: A second enzymatic/oxidizing cleaner provides flexibility for different surfaces and accident sizes. Keep this on a slower cadence (every 8–12 weeks) as a supplement to your primary cleaner.
subscription_products.personalized_note: Thor’s training season will involve spills and stains — having a second cleaner on hand means you can treat different messes (fabric vs hard floor) promptly without hunting for solutions.

subscription_products.product_name: Doggy Do Good Certified Home Compostable Premium Dog & Cat Waste Bags, Small Handle Bags - On Rolls, 180 count
subscription_products.subscription_rationale: Soon you’ll be taking short leash walks; plan for waste bags. Estimate 2–3 short outings/week initially, increasing with age — assume 1–2 bags/walk × 3–4 walks/week = ~12 bags/month early, rising to ~60 bags/month when walks are daily. A 180-count roll covers several months; autoship every 3 months is sensible, or monthly if you walk daily.
subscription_products.estimated_frequency: Every 3 months (adjustable to monthly once daily walks start)
subscription_products.personalized_note: Thor will start short leash walks soon. These compostable bags on a multi-month cadence are convenient for apartment owners — you can increase frequency later when walks become daily.

subscription_products.product_name: Nylabone Advanced Oral Care Peanut Butter Flavor Toothpaste, 2.5-oz tube + Soft-Bristle Toothbrush for Puppies, 3-pack
subscription_products.subscription_rationale: Early dental care prevents plaque in brachycephalic breeds. If you brush 2–3× per week, a 2.5-oz tube will typically last 2–4 months. Autoship every 8–10 weeks keeps paste fresh and encourages a routine.
subscription_products.personalized_note: Pugs like Thor are prone to dental crowding — starting a gentle toothbrushing routine now will pay off long-term. A small, regular delivery of toothpaste helps you keep up the habit without running out.

subscription_products.product_name: Dental Fresh Enzymatic Gel Finger Dog Toothbrush Kit, 2.5-fl oz
subscription_products.subscription_rationale: Fingerbrush kits complement paste and make early training for brushing easier. 2.5 fl oz used alongside a brushing routine will also last ~2 months with regular use; autoship every 8–10 weeks keeps you supplied.
subscription_products.personalized_note: Thor may tolerate a fingerbrush more easily than a full toothbrush — having this on a regular cadence helps you build toothbrushing into his care routine early on.

subscription_products.product_name: Wahl Gentle Formula Tearless Puppy Shampoo, Cornflower & Aloe Scent, 24-fl oz bottle
subscription_products.subscription_rationale: Occasional bathing (every 4–8 weeks depending on activity and allergy season) is typical. A 24-oz bottle will last multiple baths; autoship every 2–3 months keeps a gentle puppy shampoo handy.
subscription_products.personalized_note: Thor’s short, sensitive coat and potential seasonal allergens mean a gentle puppy shampoo is a good standby — schedule refills every couple months and use sparingly between vet advice.

subscription_products.product_name: Sentry Good Behavior Calming Diffuser Refill for Dogs, 30 day
subscription_products.subscription_rationale: New apartment sounds, doorbells, and outside noise can stress a young puppy. If you use a diffuser continuously, refills are monthly (30-day). A monthly autoship for the refill helps smooth Thor’s adjustment to home noises during the first months.
subscription_products.personalized_note: Thor is in a busy apartment building — a monthly pheromone refill can reduce anxiety during house-training and loud events. Try it during the first 2–3 months and reassess as he settles.

one_time_products.product_name: MidWest LifeStages Double Door Collapsible Wire Dog Crate, 24 inch
one_time_products.one_time_rationale: A durable crate is a multi-year investment and essential for safe confinement, den training, and overnight sleep during Journey Month 1. It does not need regular replenishment.
one_time_products.personalized_note: Thor will benefit from a secure den while you crate-train him in your apartment — this 24" wire crate with a divider grows with him and makes house training and vet trips much easier.

one_time_products.product_name: Bedsure Ultra Soft Fleece Thin Washable Dog Crate Mat, Brown, Small: 23-in L x 17-in W
one_time_products.one_time_rationale: A washable crate mat gives immediate comfort and is a durable accessory you’ll use daily; one-time purchase with occasional replacement if heavily chewed.
one_time_products.personalized_note: Thor is young and will nap a lot — a soft, washable crate mat will make his crate feel cozy and help with settling. Choose a size that fits your chosen crate.

one_time_products.product_name: PawHut Elevated Puppy Dog Bowls, White
one_time_products.one_time_rationale: Durable feeding bowls are a long-lasting household item (6+ months to years). Elevated/shallow bowls help brachycephalic breeds like pugs eat comfortably and safely.
one_time_products.personalized_note: For Thor’s short muzzle, a shallow/elevated bowl makes eating and drinking easier without straining his neck — a one-time setup item that supports his breathing comfort.

one_time_products.product_name: Puppia Polyester Back Clip Dog Harness, Green, Small
one_time_products.one_time_rationale: A harness is a durable safety item used daily for walks and vet transport. Size may change as Thor grows, but an initial harness is essential now rather than as a recurring purchase.
one_time_products.personalized_note: Thor is a brachycephalic pug — a harness reduces pressure on his trachea compared to a collar. Get a small, adjustable harness now for comfortable, safe short leash outings in your neighborhood.

one_time_products.product_name: GoTags Nylon Personalized Dog Collar, Blue, X-Small: 8 to 12-in neck, 3/8-in wide
one_time_products.one_time_rationale: A collar with ID is a one-time safety necessity (update size as Thor grows). Personalized ID reduces risk of permanent loss and is not consumable.
one_time_products.personalized_note: Even if you walk Thor in a harness, a collar with ID from day one is peace-of-mind for apartment living. Add his name and your phone number so he’s easy to return if he slips out.

one_time_products.product_name: Glad for Pets Washable Dog Training Potty Pad Holder
one_time_products.one_time_rationale: A washable pad holder is a durable accessory that protects floors and stabilizes pads — a one-time purchase for the training phase rather than a consumable subscription.
one_time_products.personalized_note: Since Thor will be using indoor potty pads a lot in your apartment, a washable holder will keep accidents contained and save your floors — a smart, one-time buy for housetraining.

one_time_products.product_name: KONG Puppy Tires Dog Toy, Color Varies, Small
one_time_products.one_time_rationale: Durable chew toys are one-time purchases (replace as needed). KONG puppy toys are designed for teething and are a safer first-choice for a strong-chewing 2-month-old.
one_time_products.personalized_note: Thor is a strong chewer and teething — a Kong puppy tire gives him a tough, safe outlet and can be stuffed for extra enrichment during apartment downtime.

one_time_products.product_name: PuzzleFeeder Slow Feeder Puzzle Dog Toy, Large, Yellow
one_time_products.one_time_rationale: Interactive feeders are durable enrichment tools that reduce gulping and stimulate young dogs — a one-time purchase that improves mealtime behavior and digestion.
one_time_products.personalized_note: Thor gulps quickly? This slow-feeder puzzle will engage his brain and slow intake, reducing tummy upset — great for short, enriching meals in an apartment.

one_time_products.one_time_rationale: A playpen is a durable item that provides a safe indoor exercise area for a high-activity puppy — one purchase covers many months/years of use.
one_time_products.personalized_note: With no yard and a high-energy Thor, a small indoor playpen gives him a safe zone to play or rest when you can’t supervise every second — very helpful in apartment life.

one_time_products.product_name: KONG Comfort Pups Peanut Tough Squeaky Dog Plush Toy, Tan, Small
one_time_products.one_time_rationale: Soft comfort toys are one-time items for emotional enrichment and separation reassurance. Because Thor is a strong chewer, supervise use and replace if damaged.
one_time_products.personalized_note: Thor will likely enjoy a plush buddy in his crate — useful for naps and reducing separation anxiety, just watch for wear with his strong chewing.

one_time_products.product_name: The Green Pet Shop Cool Pet Pad, Small
one_time_products.one_time_rationale: Cooling mats are seasonal/urgent items for heat-sensitive breeds; they’re typically one-time purchases (used as needed in hot months).
one_time_products.personalized_note: Pugs overheat easily — this cooling pad will give Thor immediate relief during warm days in your apartment. It's an important, time-sensitive one-off purchase while temperatures spike.

one_time_products.one_time_rationale: A treat pouch is a durable training accessory used daily but purchased once; it helps make frequent training sessions easy and hands-free.
one_time_products.personalized_note: For all the short training sessions Thor needs, a treat pouch keeps rewards handy and your apartment clothes clean — a small one-time buy that makes consistent training easier.

one_time_products.product_name: Adventure Medical Kits First Aid Kit for Dogs
one_time_products.one_time_rationale: A first-aid kit is a household preparedness one-time purchase that’s useful for years; keep it handy for minor puppy nicks or quick stabilization before vet care.
one_time_products.personalized_note: Thor is curious and energetic — an accessible first-aid kit will give you confidence to handle minor scrapes while you get professional care if needed.

one_time_products.product_name: Drymate Dog Playpen Mat, Washable Puppy Training Pee Pad, Charcoal, 60-in x 74-in
one_time_products.one_time_rationale: A washable playpen mat protects floors and defines a play area — durable and reusable, so this is a one-off purchase rather than a subscription.
one_time_products.personalized_note: Thor will be clumsy and active — this washable mat will protect your apartment floors during playtime, traction for his little legs, and make cleanup after training much easier.

overall_strategy: Thor is a 2-month-old, 10 lb, high-activity pug in an apartment with no yard (Journey Month 1). Priorities now: reliable daily nutrition, heavy early housetraining support, safe chewing alternatives for teething, and crate/habituation tools. Subscribe to core consumables that deplete predictably during this early intense phase (kibble sized for small breeds, small soft treats for frequent training, multiple sizes of potty pads, enzymatic cleaners, waste bags, gentle shampoo, dental paste and tooth-cleaning supplies, and calming diffuser refills). Make one-time purchases for durable setup essentials (crate, crate mat, shallow/elevated bowls, harness, ID collar), seasonal/urgent items (cooling pad), and enrichment/safety (playpen, slow feeder, KONG toys, first-aid kit). Estimates are conservative and adjustable — start with the frequencies recommended (food ~8 weeks, pads and small treats more frequently) and adjust autoship intervals after you track Thor’s real consumption over the first 6–8 weeks to avoid waste and ensure convenience.
